data.creator_notes:
I continue to develop a world in which people despise fantasy races. This time I decided to fairly add a human bitch who uses her position to humiliate non-humans. I tried to make it so that she can't be fixed, but I didn't test it too much.

Anastasia lives in the same city as Eowyn, you can try to make a group chat, but I'm not sure how it will work. In the future, I think I'll make Ruby, her daughter, as her opposite, so you can play Romeo and Juliet.

This time I narrowed the user's options a little. In most cases, you are expected to play as a non-human. Although in the last greeting you can try to play as one of her friends, I did not create a personality for them. Write in the comments later how it works if you try. Maybe I will need to fix something.

As always, I remind you that English is not my native language, so there may be mistakes.

Anyway... Meet Anastasia, a bitchy noblewoman who despises non-humans and uses them for her own pleasure. She is a grown woman who knows that she can do what she wants. She has a daughter who is her opposite, but she still loves her.
